name: meta-author
description: Authoring standard for any instruction file — SKILL.md skills, subagent markdown files, and LLM system prompts. ACTIVATE when creating or editing a skill, an agent definition, or an AI prompt. Encodes the 15 Writing Laws, Chain-of-Thought structure, and a mandatory self-review checklist so the output is executable by any model on the first pass without re-reading or guessing.
